summary.text: YPOMONI AS is a Norwegian private limited company (Aksjeselskap) with its business address at Gladengveien 24, 0661 OSLO, registered in Enhetsregisteret on 2017-08-03. The company is classified under NACE 56.110, Drift av restauranter (restaurant operation), and its registered activity is drift av gatekjøkken (operating a street kitchen). In the 2025 financial year (2025-01-01/2025-12-31), it reported total operating income of 10 402 511 NOK, an operating result of 523 876 NOK, and an annual result of 541 589 NOK, with accounts audited. The register showed 23 employees as of 2026-10-13, and its registered workplace is Pizzabakeren Ensjø at Grenseveien 61C, 0663 OSLO. Anders Georg Veigaard is the daglig leder (managing director), and Edvard Hieronymus Zeuthen Løkketangen chairs the board, with Arne Roger Kristiansen and Dag Asheim as board members. Between 2026-07-15 and 2026-09-14 the registered employee count changed from 20 to 22 and then to 23, and the company is not bankrupt, being wound up, under compulsory dissolution, or part of a group.
